claims.location: comment[label], characteristics[compound], characteristics[dose], characteristics[exposure duration], factor value[compound]
claims.value: R1 and R2: heavy (Arg10/Lys8) = 1 uM dTAG-7, light = DMSO; R3: label swap (heavy = DMSO, light = dTAG-7); same in the PROTAC (-IR) and PROTAC_IR series
claims.evidence: Paper: 'differentially labeled HeLa Ufd1-dTAG cells were treated with dTAG-7 or DMSO control for 8 h, or with dTAG-7 or DMSO for 4 h and irradiated 1 h after the start of treatment'; dTAG-7 1 uM. Data (GlyGly (K)Sites.txt, median log2 H/L normalized of diGly sites): RAD21 +0.80/+0.72/-0.61 (R1/R2/R3, -IR) and +0.28/+0.53/-0.93 (+IR); HUS1 +0.71/+0.93/-1.08; MORF4L1 +0.43/+0.82/-0.54; FKBP1A (FKBP12F36V tag, ubiquitylated upon dTAG engagement) +1.22/+0.74/-1.05 (-IR) and +0.91/+0.79/-0.52 (+IR). The paper names RAD21, HUS1, XRCC1 and MORF4L1 as targets with increased ubiquitylation upon Ufd1 degradation, so heavy = dTAG-7 in R1/R2 and light = dTAG-7 in R3.

claims.value: PROTAC series: no irradiation ('control'), 8 h dTAG-7/DMSO; PROTAC_IR series: Ionizing Radiation (2 Gy) 1 h after start of a 4 h dTAG-7/DMSO treatment
claims.evidence: Paper: 'cells subjected to ionizing radiation (IR, 2 Gy)'; Fig. 1 legend: '(C) Analysis of unchallenged cells (-IR, 8 h dTAG treatment) or (D) cells challenged with ionizing radiation (+IR, 1 h dTAG pretreatment, continued for 3 h after 2 Gy IR)'

limitations: dTAG-7 has no NCIT/ChEBI term; it is given by name in characteristics[compound]. Irradiation status is carried by characteristics[treatment] (Ionizing Radiation, NCIT:C17052 vs control); the 2 Gy dose is in the source name because characteristics[dose] units do not include Gy and the dose column holds the dTAG-7 concentration.
Exposure duration is the dTAG-7/DMSO treatment length (8 h without IR; 4 h with IR, irradiated at 1 h).
The MaxQuant search enzyme was Trypsin/P; the wet-lab enzyme trypsin is annotated.
